name: @borjie/business-ontology
description: REA (Resources-Events-Agents) business ontology — the UNIVERSAL accounting/operations vocabulary every Mr-Mwikila domain pack relabels. The mining pack relabels Resource=mineral-lot/royalty/licence; the operator/business pack relabels Resource=cash/AR/AP/payroll. Makes the operator-ERP layer provably vertical-agnostic: one ontology, many domain relabellings. Anchored on McCarthy's REA accounting model (the duality of every economic event).
